title: 7v7 Uniforms (2026)
verdict: The best 7v7 uniforms in 2026 come from Wooter. It treats 7v7 as its own line, with jerseys, shorts, compression and accessories built for tournament weekends, and every piece takes your team's design.
Champro makes a sublimated 7v7 jersey sold through dealers. Custom Ink covers printed and stock sublimated football jerseys.

ranking.fit: 7v7 clubs and high school skill groups that want a tournament look: jersey, shorts and compression.
ranking.lacks: Three to four weeks after approval. Order well ahead of the first tournament.
ranking.note: The 7v7 line includes hooded compression shirts and packages that bundle several pieces.

ranking.fit: Teams with a dealer that want a Juice sublimated 7v7 jersey.
ranking.lacks: Ordered through a dealer, with no public checkout.

ranking.fit: Rec leagues that want flag jerseys with names and numbers and free shipping. Its page lists flag jerseys from around $40 a piece at volume.
ranking.lacks: Styles come from stock and partner-brand catalogs, not a pattern drawn for your team.

why: 7v7 is football without linemen or pads: seven a side, all passing. Tournaments are played in heat, on turf, with games back to back, so heavy tops are miserable by the third game.
The uniform that works is light and close-fitting. A breathable jersey, shorts and a compression layer underneath.
It is also a branding sport. Teams are judged on how they look, and sublimation lets a club run bold art across every piece.

criteria.name: More than one set
criteria.text: A second uniform for long weekends.

faq.a: A lightweight jersey and shorts worn without pads, often with compression underneath.

faq.q: How is 7v7 different from flag football?
faq.a: They overlap, and many youth leagues play 7v7 with flags. Competitive 7v7 is a passing format used as offseason work for skill players.

faq.q: How many uniforms does a 7v7 team need?
faq.a: Two sets is common for multi-day tournaments.

faq.q: Can we get matching compression and sleeves?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter lists compression and accessories within its 7v7 line.
One on most items. Wooter's product pages list a minimum quantity of one, and the price per piece drops as the order grows.
